lmxxf_rdna4.pin_reason: 0.38 is the reproducible stable package baseline. e65ba051 is the latest inspected post-0.38 commit whose production change was explicitly accepted/installed and bit-exact; later 48a14184, 4c207ff4 and 640493c9 record smoke/ledger or candidates that were null, not taken, or slower, so the quality-first post-release source pin stops at e65ba051.

do_not_enable_by_default.reason: Intentionally lossy compact 1080 tier; quality-first CONTROL baseline keeps NVIDIA geometry.
QKV_PIPE was bit-exact but null and remains off.
HIP_DEC_NT was bit-exact but not taken.
SP_ENDS was not taken because the current 1080 baseline was slower.
ViT gather fold/C512 dead-store experiment was bit-exact but not taken; macros stay off.
Lossy temporal reuse can soften subtle motion; quality-first CONTROL validation keeps it off.

mochizuki_dlssnr_amd.windows_status_at_commit: same changes are present under windows/ but were not yet game-tested
control_relevant_changes: Normalise DLSSNR.MVecScale by the motion texture's own active region rather than colour size.
Use full-resolution game motion vectors in place where the resource supports it instead of a quarter-resolution copy.
Honor non-zero motion-vector and depth subrect bases.
Use sigmoid(network) times model blend_scale 0.7397 for temporal history weight.
mochizuki_dlssnr_amd.port_policy: Adapt semantics to the CONTROL host and validate geometry before changing live rendering; do not blindly copy Linux/Vulkan code into AMDNR.

theautomatic.use: full-source integration reference for AmdBridge/lmxxf lifecycle and backend switching
theautomatic.live_replace_policy: do not replace the live AMDNR host with this package while FSR Ray Regeneration is required
theautomatic.quality_note: Its adaptive ViT reuse defaults are performance-oriented and slightly lossy; keep adaptive reuse off for the CONTROL quality baseline.
